protocol.error: Exactly one height has a delayed second-hand release; the other two match the control for the same seed
protocol.delay: Fixed piston position during the actual hand delay, continued heat exchange; actual signed gap passed to transient contact loss
protocol.selection: Unchanged: earliest accepted peak-to-peak 3 cycles; no fallback to fewer cycles
protocol.reporting: Individual complete three-height fits; gamma range and mean summarize calculable attempts only, invalid attempts listed separately
protocol.interpretation: Diagnostic only. No new acceptance requirement or parameter tuning.
